import numpy as np
def equation(t, P, params):
    p = params
    return (p[0] + p[1]*P + p[2]*P**2 + p[3]*np.log(P) + p[4]/P
            + p[5]*t + p[6]*t*P + p[7]*t*P**2 + p[8]*t/P + p[9]*t**2)
